rows.speaker: The Edel
rows.en: Nice, oh nice! This many forces gathered together -- this is truly a battle paradise!
rows.display_text:
「Nice, oh nice! This many forces
gathered together -- this is truly a
battle paradise!」

rows.speaker: The Edel
rows.en: Now then... all that's left is to wait for the guests of honor. Come on, boys and girls!

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: What a number!
rows.display_text: 「What a number!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: It's not just the numbers! Every enemy boss and ace is here, all lined up!
rows.display_text:
「It's not just the numbers! Every enemy
boss and ace is here, all lined up!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Can we win this...?
rows.display_text: 「Can we win this...?」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Nothing to do but go for it! Not after coming this far!
rows.display_text:
「Nothing to do but go for it! Not after
coming this far!」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Let's gather all of our strength together and fight!
rows.display_text:
「Let's gather all of our strength
together and fight!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Operation time is 12 minutes... That's the limit for how long we can hold the front line.
rows.display_text:
「Operation time is 12 minutes... that's
the limit for holding the front line.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Twelve minutes... We'll put everything we have into it...!
rows.display_text:
「Twelve minutes... We'll put everything
we have into it...!」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Let's do this! The gamble of a lifetime!
rows.display_text: 「Let's do this! The gamble of a lifetime!」

rows.speaker: The Edel
rows.en: OK! Both sides, are you ready!
rows.display_text: 「OK! Both sides, are you ready!」

rows.speaker: The Edel
rows.en: Then let's get started! It's time for the Final Ultimate Gorgeous Final Battle!!
rows.display_text:
「Then let's get started! It's time for
the Final Ultimate Gorgeous Final Battle!!」

rows.speaker: The Edel
rows.en: Ah... I said 'final' twice.
rows.display_text: 「Ah... I said 'final' twice.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: We did it! We did it! This is our victory!
rows.display_text:
「We did it! We did it! This is our
victory!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: This much is nothing at all.
rows.display_text: 「This much is nothing at all.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Y-you sure? I think that was pretty rough.
rows.display_text:
「Y-you sure? I think that was pretty
rough.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Well... all's well that ends well. Good work, everyone!
rows.display_text:
「Well... all's well that ends well. Good
work, everyone!」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Looks like we'll get to enjoy the sweet taste of victory tonight.
rows.display_text:
「Looks like we'll get to enjoy the sweet
taste of victory tonight.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Thank you, everyone. Let's all celebrate today's victory together.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, everyone. Let's all celebrate
today's victory together.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: The operation's 12-minute time limit has passed...!
rows.display_text:
「The operation's 12-minute time limit has
passed...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: This power really is on a whole different level from any enemy we've fought so far...!
rows.display_text:
「This power really is on a whole
different level from any enemy we've
fought so far...!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Damn it! We're steadily being pushed back!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! We're steadily being pushed
back!」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: This is bad! If we keep fighting like this, all that's waiting for us is annihilation!
rows.display_text:
「This is bad! If we keep fighting like
this, all that's waiting for us is
annihilation!」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: Even with all our strength combined, we still can't beat that army...!?
rows.display_text:
「Even with all our strength combined, we
still can't beat that army...!?」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: What's the enemy's formation like?
rows.display_text: 「What's the enemy's formation like?」

rows.speaker: Murrue
rows.en: According to the recon team's report, every enemy force we've fought so far has gathered together.
rows.display_text:
「According to the recon team's report,
every enemy force we've fought so far
has gathered here.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: So it's the enemy's all-star lineup, huh. Damn it... this is rough.
rows.display_text:
「So it's the enemy's all-star lineup, huh.
Damn it... this is rough.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: But hope still remains. ...And that hope is our own existence.
rows.display_text:
「But hope still remains. ...And that hope
is our own existence.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: That's right! We've got an all-star lineup of our own too!
rows.display_text:
「That's right! We've got an all-star
lineup of our own too!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Our forces are evenly matched... Nothing to do but go for it.
rows.display_text:
「Our forces are evenly matched... Nothing
to do but go for it.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Now that we've come this far, let's steel our resolve.
rows.display_text:
「Now that we've come this far, let's
steel our resolve.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: If we're already defeated in our hearts, we won't be able to accomplish anything. It's our feelings that give birth to strength.
rows.display_text:
「If we're already defeated in our
hearts, we can't accomplish anything. Our
feelings are what give birth to strength.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Prepare to sortie. We'll clash head-on, strength against strength, and settle every one of these battles once and for all...!
rows.display_text:
「Prepare to sortie. We'll clash head-on,
strength against strength, and settle all
these battles once and for all...!」
